description: AutoMuteUs bot fleet: games, mute/deafen routing, Discord API pressure, multi-process coordination, and process health.

spec.description: Distinct games in progress. Twin pods (N and N+10) both subscribe to every game on their shards, so this takes the max per shard group instead of summing every subscription.
spec.title: Active Games

spec.description: Mute/deafen changes successfully applied per minute, all routes.
spec.title: Voice Changes / min

spec.description: Games started with /new in the selected time range.
spec.title: Games Started

spec.description: Games ended in the selected time range, all reasons.
spec.title: Games Ended

spec.description: Bot pods being scraped successfully. Expected: 20.
spec.title: Bot Pods Up

spec.description: Counter resets of games_started per pod in the selected range. A full rollout is 20; anything outside a rollout is a crash. (process_start_time_seconds is not retained by Alloy.)
spec.title: Process Restarts

spec.description: Share of mute/deafen changes that failed on every route in the selected range.
spec.title: Voice Failure %

spec.description: 429 responses observed in the selected range.
spec.title: Discord Rate Limits

spec.description: Capture-client mute tasks that timed out without an ack (the client gets blacklisted).
spec.title: Capture Tasks Unacked

spec.description: Should stay at zero. A lease renewal failed or a burst stalled past the TTL.
spec.title: Consumer Leases Lost

spec.description: End-of-game cleanup steps that failed in the selected range.
spec.title: Cleanup Failures

spec.description: Mute/deafen attempts on a premium worker token that failed and fell back to another route.
spec.title: Worker Token Fallbacks

spec.description: Distinct games per shard group (max across the two twin pods). Stacked; the top edge is the fleet total.
spec.title: Active Games by Shard Group

spec.description: Raw per-pod gauge. Twin pods N and N+10 should track each other; a twin that sits at zero while the other is busy has stopped adopting games.
spec.title: Game Subscriptions by Pod
Game Starts and Ends per minute

spec.description: Spikes in inactivity or capture_shutdown usually mean capture-side trouble, not user behaviour.
spec.title: Game Ends per minute by Reason

spec.description: Total games ended per reason in the selected range.
spec.title: End Reasons (range)

spec.description: primary = the bot's own token, worker = premium worker tokens, capture = the capture client's token.
spec.title: Voice Changes per minute by Route

spec.description: Changes that failed after all fallbacks, by the route that last handled them.
spec.title: Voice Change Failures per minute by Route

spec.description: Gaps mean no voice changes happened in that interval.
spec.title: Voice Failure Ratio

spec.description: Wall time to apply one batch of mute/deafen changes across all routes. Quantiles are interpolated within histogram buckets.
spec.title: Mute Batch Duration

spec.description: Where batches actually land, not just the percentiles. A second dark band above the main one means one route is consistently slow.
spec.title: Mute Batch Duration Distribution

spec.description: throttled = the bot withheld the task to protect the client's rate limit. unacked = no ack before timeout; client is blacklisted.
spec.title: Capture Mute Tasks per minute by Result

spec.description: Worker-token attempts that failed and were retried on another route. Not final failures.
spec.title: Worker Token Fallbacks per minute

spec.description: 429 responses per minute, by pod.
spec.title: Discord Rate Limits per minute

spec.description: Coarse activity counters, not an exact HTTP request count.
spec.title: Message Operations per minute by Type

spec.description: Counts per interval. Handovers happen while a process drains; adoptions are standby subscriptions to games created elsewhere.
spec.title: Handovers and Adoptions

spec.description: Waits are normal under load (end-of-game waited for another process to finish a burst). Losses should stay at zero.
spec.title: Consumer Lease Waits and Losses
Worker Cleanup Checks per minute by Result

spec.description: Fleet-wide backlog of guilds queued for worker departures.
spec.title: Guilds Pending Worker Departure

spec.description: Age of the oldest pending guild check. Growing steadily means the cleanup loop is falling behind.
spec.title: Oldest Scheduled Check Age

spec.description: One core = 100%.
spec.title: CPU by Process

spec.description: A steady climb that never comes down is a goroutine leak.
spec.title: Goroutines by Process

spec.description: Longest stop-the-world GC pause in the current summary window. Spikes here line up with slow mute batches.
spec.title: GC Pause (max per cycle) by Process
